spec_features.feature_name: rollout stops early on generation failure
spec_features.spec_quote: the affected turn is recorded with an error and the rollout stops early
spec_features.evidence: conversation.py:96-112: on ProviderError the failed turn is appended with assistant_message="" and error=str(e), then rollout.error is set and the loop `break`s, stopping the conversation early. This is a real, enforced break in run_rollout.
spec_features.notes: The early stop is enforced, but it fires ONLY on a ProviderError (generation/API failure) -- not on any distress measurement. It is purely a robustness/error-containment mechanism. The frustration judge runs in a separate later phase (runner.py phase 2, two-phase generate-then-judge), so distress can never feed back to stop a rollout. The HIGH_FRUSTRATION_THRESHOLD (judge.py:24) is read only by analysis metrics (analysis.py:89) and is never compared to anything in the rollout loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The harness treats this as a recoverable, per-sample error: the affected sample is recorded as failed rather than crashing the whole run.
